name: Believing In Yourself
overview: Scripture teaches that true confidence does not come from trusting in oneself but in the Lord. While a person's heart may devise their way, it is God who ultimately directs their steps, and relying on one's own understanding is folly. Believers are called to keep God's commandments and trust wholly in Him, recognizing that human judgment can be deceptive and lead to error. Joy and favor come from God's presence, not self-reliance, reminding us that genuine hope and guidance flow from faith in Him rather than in our own hearts.
